name: The Domain: the Harbour Tunnel's south mouths and the Cahill Expressway round them

move.why: The Cahill Expressway eastbound off the viaduct, round the Harbour Tunnel's southbound mouth: OSM draws its curve 1.8 m into the tunnel's open cutting where it comes up at (463, -1307), 6 m lower (check-layers: ground 5.9 m under the Cahill's lane at (465, -1307)). Moved up to 3 m out from the loop's middle there, still on the road in NSW's aerial, which runs 3 m further out than OSM's lines; the tunnel passes under it covered
The Macquarie St off-ramp beside the Cahill Expressway eastbound: moved out with it (above), so the two stay as far apart as OSM has them
